description: The state education department has prepared a draft policy proposing a three-tier artificial intelligence (AI) training programme for five lakh students across higher education institutions, ranging from basic AI literacy to discipline-specific applications and advanced, employment-oriented skills.
body_lead: Gandhinagar: The state education department has prepared a draft policy proposing a three-tier artificial intelligence (AI) training programme for five lakh students across higher education institutions, ranging from basic AI literacy to discipline-specific applications and advanced, employment-oriented skills. The Gujarat AI for Every Student Mission 2026-27 aims to rapidly scale AI education across Gujarat.
